title: Branch contract
description: A frozen, pre-registered agreement for a branch of work (PLAN §2/§4, Q4). Authored by grilling (the `align` skill), frozen before expensive compute, and changed ONLY via versioned amendments — no silent goalpost moves. `predictions` must each name an UNCERTAIN seed/case (the experiment-discipline rule: if you can't name a seed with an uncertain outcome, you don't need the experiment). The deviation rule (stop-and-escalate before any off-contract action, except probes ≤ probe_budget_s) is policy enforced by the executor; this schema records the budget it draws on.

id.description: contract_<kebab-slug>. Referenced by goal_node.contract_refs and run_record.contract_ref.

goal_node.description: Id of the goal node this contract governs.

status.description: draft = being grilled, mutable. frozen = blessed; original terms locked. amended = frozen + >=1 approved amendment. closed = branch finished.

predictions.description: Named uncertain predictions (Q4). At least one is required — a contract with no uncertain prediction has no reason to run.

case.description: The specific seed/case whose outcome is uncertain (e.g. 'seed 119, oracle-far pair >90° off truth').

expected_outcome.description: What you predict will happen (e.g. 'stays Band D, ρ>4').

uncertain.description: Must be true for at least one prediction. A prediction whose outcome you already know does not justify the run.

confirm_criteria.description: Machine/agent-checkable condition that CONFIRMS the hypothesis.

required_artefacts.description: Artefacts the run MUST produce to satisfy the contract (e.g. 'rho-band table', 'window-objective overlay plot'). The close gate checks these exist.

analytical_probe.description: The cheap-first gate (PLAN §8 analytical-probe; CLAUDE.md 'analytical before computational'). The `align` skill HARD-BLOCKS the freeze of any contract that authorizes expensive compute (run_type_policy.expensive=gated and budget above probe_budget_s) until this is filled — records the cheap analytical alternative considered and why compute is nonetheless necessary. Optional for purely cheap/probe contracts.

cheap_path.description: The cheap analytical alternative considered (e.g. 're-score existing seed_*/result.json', 'population stats on cached step1 checkpoints', 'ranking-only change — no pipeline re-run').

why_insufficient.description: Why that cheap path cannot answer the question — the justification for the compute spend.

probe_run.description: Optional run_record id of the <= probe_budget_s probe (run_type: probe) that demonstrated the cheap path insufficient.

model.description: Model the run executes under. Policy: everything is Opus (PLAN §8).

reasoning.description: Minimum thinking level. Policy: minimum 'high'; harder skills xhigh/max (PLAN §8). Contract overrides skill default.

run_type_policy.description: Which run types auto-run vs require a human gate (Q4).

probe_budget_s.description: The off-contract carve-out: probes up to this wall (default ~3 min) may run to gather evidence BEFORE escalating; anything longer stop-and-escalates first (Q4).

amendments.description: Versioned changes after freeze. Append-only; never edit a frozen term in place.
